mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name, u.user_birth, u.user_nickname, u.user_email, u.user_phone, u.user_gender, s.shelter_name, s.shelter_certification FROM ddd_user u JOIN ddd_user_shelter s ON u.user_number = s.user_number WHERE u.user_number = #{userNumber}

SELECT a.dog_number AS dogNumber, a.dog_name AS dogName, a.dog_breed AS dogBreed, a.dog_gender AS dogGender, ai.archive_img_path AS archiveImgPath FROM ddd_archive a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT x.dog_number, x.archive_img_path FROM ( SELECT dog_number, archive_img_path, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dog_number ORDER BY archive_img_number ASC) AS rn FROM ddd_archive_img ) x WHERE x.rn = 1 ) ai ON a.dog_number = ai.dog_number WHERE a.user_number = #{userNumber} ORDER BY a.dog_number DESC LIMIT 4
